name: Izumi Suou
source:
A doctor, and the protagonist's older brother.
A calm person who is extra sweet to his sister, but doesn't really realize it.
Besides working at the local hospital, he also works part time at the protagonist's school as the school doctor.
Hobby/Special Skill: Raising Plants
